name: Upset
overview: Scripture reveals that being upset and the experience of temptation or distress are realities even Jesus faced, as seen when He was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted (Matthew 4:1) and when He withdrew with His disciples to a garden (John 18:1). Believers are instructed not to seek personal vengeance or act in wrath but to trust God's righteous judgment, for He alone is the rightful avenger (Romans 12:19; Romans 13:4). Throughout all circumstances, Jesus Christ remains unchanging and steadfast, offering a firm foundation for believers amid upset and trials (Hebrews 13:8).
